cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The small trophy is better. It shows restraint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Exactly. How gracefully can your enormous cup fit in a cupboard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And mine doesn't need to shout. Another victory in modesty.
